absent.reason: no share-count factor code and no share-count row field
the solvency category carries only RATIOS, never an absolute debt level
no preferred-equity code among the 289 registry factors
no minority-interest code among the 289 registry factors
'Cash to Market Value' is a ratio; no absolute cash level
the value category carries trailing ('Earnings Yield') and NTM ('Earnings Yield NTM') only -- no second-forward-year estimate at any grain
the registry carries only 'Leverage' (category solvency) and states no numerator or denominator, so reading it AS debt/equity would be inferred, not measured; 'Debt to Assets' is debt to ASSETS
no net-debt code among the 289 registry factors
no net-debt code among the 289 registry factors
the growth category tops out at a THREE-year window
no EBIT growth measure at any window ('EBIT to Enterprise Value' is a yield, 'EBIT Estimate Revisions (45D)' an estimate revision)
no FCF growth measure at any window ('Free Cash Flow Yield' and 'Free Cash Flow to Enterprise Value NTM' are yields)

denominators.self_exclusion_rule: a row is the subject itself when its ticker is the key's root or the subject's own scanner ticker, or when its name normalises EXACTLY to the subject's (upper-case alphanumerics, no suffix stripping); it is the subject's OWN OTHER SHARE CLASS when stripping a trailing 'Class <X>'/'Cl <X>' marker from both names (and nothing else) leaves them equal, with the marker present on at least one side (row AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W25-S6, AMGT-rk-13 AC3) -- catching the same issuer under two share classes without the token-overlap over-exclusion reverted at row AMGT_RESAPP-Z-W25-S3

payload.test: comparable = the deepest of four lexicographic rungs the candidate reaches: (1) same SECTOR (scanner UniverseDataRow.sector; a model-block subject's GICS_SECTOR_NAME is mapped into that vocabulary by GICS11_TO_SCANNER13_v1), then (2) a SIZE BAND of 0.2x-5.0x of the subject's market cap (UniverseDataRow.mktVal in USD millions; a model-block subject's CUR_MKT_CAP divided by 1e6), then (3) same COUNTRY (UniverseDataRow.country; CNTRY_OF_DOMICILE mapped by ISO3166A2_TO_SCANNER_COUNTRY_v1), then (4) same SUBSECTOR (UniverseDataRow.industryGroup); ties inside the deepest rung broken by the numeric similarity |log(candidate cap / subject cap)|. Similarity of business and scale, never valuation.
